EC4: systemic disorders such as diabetes [OR], rheumatoid arthritis [OR], haematological diseases (coagulopathy) [OR] , severe cardiovascular diseases [OR], infections [OR], immunodepression;
EC5: patients in therapy with anticoagulants [OR] or antiaggregants;
EC6: use of NSAIDs in the 5 days before blood donation;
EC7: patients with Hb values < 11 g/dl [OR]  and platelet values < 150,000/mmc.
